issues.description: The field 'firstName' in Person has different visibility in the template and the solution. In the template Person.java the field is declared private, whereas in the solution Person.java it is declared public. This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended encapsulation of the model and whether they should access the field directly or via getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of 'firstName' consistent across template and solution. Prefer keeping the field private and using the existing getter/setter (i.e., change the solution's 'public String firstName;' to 'private String firstName;') to maintain encapsulation and avoid confusing students about direct field access.
